claims: The creator of One Piece is Eiichiro Oda.
Eiichiro Oda was born in Kumamoto, Japan.
The first episode of the One Piece anime aired on October 20, 1999.
On October 20, 1999, the sunset in Kumamoto was at 5:40 PM.
The first episode of the Dragon Ball anime aired on February 26, 1986.
On February 26, 1986, the sunset in Kumamoto was at 6:11 PM.
Between October 20, 1999, and February 26, 1986, the day with the earlier sunset was October 20, 1999.
The difference in sunset times between October 20, 1999, and February 26, 1986, was 31 minutes.
